exposure: Gestational age at elective CS: 38 0/7 to 38 6/7 weeks (group A), 39 0/7 to 39 6/7 weeks (group B), and 40 0/7 to 40 6/7 weeks (group C)
Gestational age at elective cesarean section
outcome: Neonatal outcomes (Apgar score, neonatal hospitalization, hypoglycemia, jaundice)
Psychomotor development at one year of age
cohort: 952 neonates born by elective cesarean section at an academic hospital in Tehran, Iran, between June 2018 and June 2020.
finding: Elective cesarean section beyond 39 weeks of gestation was associated with decreased neonatal morbidities (lower rates of low Apgar scores, neonatal hospitalization, hypoglycemia, and jaundice) and improved psychomotor development at one year of age.
